threads.body: Consider adding a regression test for the new computeIfAbsent/expunge interaction (e.g., mappingFunction performs an operation on another WeakLockFreeCache/WeakConcurrentMap that would normally trigger inline expunge) to guard against reintroducing the deadlock reported in #18232. Current CacheTest covers weak-key GC behavior but doesn’t exercise this concurrency-sensitive path.

replies.body: Added a test, but it isn't 100% reliable at reproducing the original issue.
